paper.title: Large Electron Model: A Universal Ground State Predictor
paper.authors: Timothy Zaklama, Max Geier, Liang Fu

results.system_description: 2D quantum dot: 6 electrons (6 up, 0 down) in a harmonic trap, omega = 0.015625 (Hartree units), Coulomb repulsion
results.source_location: Table I (tab:benchmarked-energies), lambda = 8.0, N = 6, 'Fermi Sets (Single Task)' column
results.eligibility_evidence: 'Produced after optimizing for a single system and sampling the converged trial wavefunction' (caption).
results.notes: Spin-polarized 2D dot, H = -1/2 sum nabla^2 + 1/2 omega sum r^2 + lambda sum 1/r_ij with omega = 1 and lambda = 8 (Sec. Physical system), i.e. oscillator units. Scaling lengths by 1/sqrt(w) maps the Hartree-unit dot at w = 1/lambda^2 = 0.015625 onto it, with E(Hartree) = w E; the convention_factor converts the printed energy. 'The parentheses around the final digit denote the standard error' (caption). The LEM foundation-model column is a jointly trained multi-system network and the DMC and FermiNet columns are quoted; none is recorded.
